decision.overall_recommendation: VIX gate is open, so new entries are technically permitted, but this system's own tracked history (60 prior ranked-picks runs, sufficient_data=true) shows only a 3.3% win rate and an average return of -3.28% per pick — a materially poor track record that argues for a highly conservative, reduced-size approach regardless of how clean today's technical setups look. The pullback-reversal screener is a real chart pattern but remains statistically unvalidated; it should not be treated as an edge on its own. Given this history, favor the picks below with a genuine recent or near-term catalyst (CTVA, HAL, SUPN, DOW, RIOT, EBAY, BG) over technically-clean-but-catalyst-light names, size well below normal risk_per_trade_pct in practice, and treat every pick as a hypothesis to be monitored closely rather than a high-conviction entry. No earnings-imminent tickers were present in this batch, so point-8 overrides did not apply.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Revenue and EPS growth are strong and accelerating (Q2 2026 revenue +30%, EPS +62% YoY), and Corteva has beaten EPS estimates in each of the last four reported quarters (e.g., $2.30 vs $2.24 est.). A genuinely material, recent catalyst: shares rose on a landmark 7-2 Supreme Court pesticide-liability ruling, plus a new BP joint venture for sustainable aviation fuel.
ranked_picks.rationale: Consistent beat record, accelerating growth, and a real, fresh regulatory win give this the strongest combined fundamentals+catalyst case in the batch.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Q4 2025 net income fell -72.5% YoY, and at +9.4% above its POC the stock has thinner volume support beneath it if the post-ruling rally stalls.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Halliburton beat EPS estimates in each of the last four quarters (e.g., $0.55 vs $0.538 est. in Q2 2026). Multiple genuine recent catalysts: a multibillion-dollar Argentina contract, a Pertamina/Indonesia deal, the Sekal drilling-automation acquisition, and a fresh analyst upgrade, backed by a strongly bullish 46-buy/1-strong-buy analyst base.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong beat record plus a genuine cluster of recent contract wins and an upgrade, with a clean (not overly-tight) RR.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The company's own Q2 2026 release flagged Middle East revenue pressure and a modest EPS surprise, and oilfield services remain highly exposed to crude-price swings outside management's control.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Supernus has beaten EPS estimates in each of the last four quarters, often by wide margins (e.g., $0.92 vs $0.28 est. in Q4 2025). It just announced an all-stock combination with Indivior to form a CNS-focused biopharma targeting $2.2B in revenue and $125M in synergies — a genuine, very recent, material catalyst.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong beat streak plus a real, fresh, transformative M&A announcement.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Q2 2026 net income growth was sharply negative (-2446% YoY per IncomeGrowth), and the pending Indivior merger introduces integration and dilution risk that a clean technical pattern doesn't address.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Dow's fundamentals are inflecting positive (Q2 2026 revenue +23.5%, net income +262% YoY) with EPS beats in each of the last four quarters. Recent News shows a real catalyst cluster: a Q2 2026 beat with raised outlook, a $2B cost-savings target, a new CEO (Karen Carter), and a 'Golden Cross' tied to its AI infrastructure bet.
ranked_picks.rationale: Improving fundamentals with a genuine, fresh news cluster (earnings beat + cost plan + leadership change).
ranked_picks.bear_case: Analyst consensus is only Hold (12 buy/19 hold/5 sell), and Dow cut its dividend in half in mid-2025 amid tariff-driven losses, so the current beat streak is a recovery off a depressed base rather than confirmed durable strength.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Riot missed EPS estimates in three of its last four quarters (e.g., -$0.68 vs -$0.30 est.) even as revenue grew. Its real, very fresh catalyst is the pivot to AI/HPC data centers — an Anthropic colocation deal (reportedly ~33% above market rates per JPMorgan) and an AMD partnership drove a sharp recent rally, with Bernstein flagging up to 80% upside.
ranked_picks.rationale: A genuinely fresh, large, business-model-changing catalyst (AI data center deals) outweighs the weak core mining EPS record for near-term momentum.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Core Bitcoin-mining EPS has consistently missed estimates, and RIOT's 3.85 beta means the AI-pivot re-rating could reverse quickly on execution slips or a crypto sentiment reversal.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: eBay beat EPS estimates in each of the last four quarters (e.g., $1.60 vs $1.50 est. in Q2 2026) on steady growth. The stock is at the center of an ongoing, very recent M&A saga — GameStop's rejected $55.5B takeover bid, with GameStop since raising its stake to ~9.8% and vowing to keep pursuing it — keeping real event risk and interest elevated.
ranked_picks.rationale: Consistent beats plus an unusually active, genuinely material ongoing M&A storyline.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The GameStop saga is unresolved and binary — eBay's board already called the offer 'neither credible nor attractive,' so the speculative premium could evaporate if GameStop walks away.
flags: StopSanityFlag: RR 28:1 reflects an unusually tight stop

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Bunge beat EPS estimates in each of the last four quarters, including a large beat in Q1 2026 ($1.83 vs $0.883 est.), alongside a Q2 2026 net-income surge (+897% YoY). At its Investor Day the company set a $15 mid-cycle EPS target by 2030 and authorized a $3B buyback — a genuine, fairly recent catalyst — with a strongly Buy-leaning analyst base (21 buy/4 hold).
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong beat record plus a concrete long-term growth/capital-return plan recently laid out to investors.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Q1 2026 revenue growth was negative (-8%), and agribusiness margins remain exposed to volatile crop prices and trade-policy swings the pattern doesn't hedge against.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Murphy Oil's income growth has accelerated sharply (Q2 2026 net income +338% YoY) with EPS beats in 3 of the last 4 quarters. A KeyBanc upgrade appears in the News, but most other recent headlines are sector-wide oil/geopolitical stories rather than Murphy-specific catalysts.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong growth and beat record, but the catalyst layer is mostly generic sector news rather than company-specific.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Analyst consensus is only Hold (9 buy/24 hold/3 sell) despite the beats, and results remain tightly linked to volatile crude prices outside the company's control.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Miami International Holdings beat EPS estimates in all five reported quarters since its August 2025 IPO (e.g., $0.48 vs $0.4084 est. in Q2 2026). Its most recent material catalyst, a Boursa Kuwait cross-listing partnership, dates to December 2025 and is no longer fresh.
ranked_picks.rationale: Clean, consistent beat record for a recent IPO, but limited trading history and no fresh catalyst.
ranked_picks.bear_case: As a recent IPO, MIAX has a short earnings history to judge through a full cycle, and Q2 2026 net income growth was actually negative (-74% YoY) even though EPS beat — a discrepancy worth watching.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Acadia Realty beat EPS estimates by wide margins in each of the last four quarters (e.g., $0.34 vs $0.085 est.), though Q2 2026 revenue and net income both declined YoY. A fresh, genuine catalyst: an analyst just turned bullish on AKR per the most recent News item.
ranked_picks.rationale: Strong beat pattern plus a just-announced analyst upgrade gives a modest fresh catalyst edge.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The size of AKR's beats versus very low analyst estimates raises questions about estimate quality, and the recent YoY revenue/income declines cut against the bullish narrative.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: HASI beat EPS estimates in each of the last four quarters (e.g., $0.75 vs $0.731 est.) with a strongly Buy-leaning analyst base (16 buy/2 hold). Its most recent material catalyst — a JPMorgan 'top pick in alternative energy' call — dates to mid-2025 and is stale.
ranked_picks.rationale: Solid beat record but no fresh catalyst, and the trade plan's stop is unusually tight.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The stop is only about 1% below entry (StopSanityFlag), meaning ordinary daily volatility could trigger it well before the fundamental thesis has time to play out.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Herbalife beat EPS estimates in 3 of its last 4 quarters, but Q2 2026 net income fell -142% YoY despite a narrow EPS miss. Its biggest genuine catalyst — Cristiano Ronaldo's stake purchase in Herbalife's Pro2col platform that sent shares up ~15% after hours — is roughly six months old and no longer fresh.
ranked_picks.rationale: Decent beat record but deteriorating income growth and a stale catalyst.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Net income growth has turned negative in the two most recent quarters despite EPS beats, suggesting margin pressure beneath the headline numbers.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Altria's income growth is positive (Q2 2026 revenue +12.6%, net income +5.3% YoY) but its EPS record is mixed (slight misses in 2 of the last 4 quarters). News is genuinely mixed: a recent headline flags inflation pushing smokers to discount brands (negative, tied to the Q2 miss), while a newer item announces a manufacturing partnership with Philip Morris International (positive).
ranked_picks.rationale: Genuinely mixed but includes one fresh positive corporate development to offset a recent soft print.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The 'smokers ditching Marlboro for discount brands' headline points to real volume/mix pressure in the core business that a rising 200-day EMA pattern doesn't offset.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Celcuity is pre-revenue and posted a wider-than-expected Q2 2026 loss (-$1.44 vs -$1.16 est.), prompting analyst forecast cuts despite a fully bullish rating base (12 buy/0 hold/0 sell). The genuine catalyst is clinical: positive Phase 3 VIKTORIA-1 data and an expanded VIKTORIA-2 trial support a coming FDA filing, though the stock has already fallen from a 52-week high of $151 to ~$91.
ranked_picks.rationale: Real, forward-looking clinical catalyst, but this is a binary biotech play, not a fundamentals-driven one.
ranked_picks.bear_case: As a pre-revenue biotech, CELC's outcome hinges entirely on binary trial/regulatory events, and the larger-than-expected recent quarterly loss shows spending outpacing estimates.
